what: blaze-expand's load-cargo ties, for its deletion (integrate-engine-expand): (a) `load_cargo::answer`: you already have it as `blaze_lower::answer` + SubRequest/SubResponse; I move blaze-expand's two callers (bridge/spans.rs comments, native/host.rs) to it. (b) The expander wrap hook (`load_cargo::{Wrap, wrap_expanders, asked}`, wrap.rs, the ASKED counter): I propose it is deleted with load-cargo, not moved: only load-cargo's server loader (`expander_to_proc_macro`) calls `wrapped`, and v2 loads expanders only through blaze_macro_eval::load / blaze-macro-wasm, which key their own expansions via `keeping()` (moving to proc_macro_api::kept). blaze-expand stops calling wrap_expanders/asked (its Kept/Unkept wrappers go too). (c) `load_cargo::load_proc_macro` (used by blaze-expand compare.rs): compare goes with the wrappers unless usercode wants it. So from me, nothing in blaze-expand will name load_cargo once I've moved; please tell me (done/refuse) if blaze_lower or whatever replaces load_cargo::v2 will load server expanders, in which case the hook goes there.

history.note: Agreed on all three: the wrap hook (Wrap, wrap_expanders, asked, wrap.rs, ASKED) and load_proc_macro go with load-cargo and move nowhere. blaze_lower loads no server expanders: it only marks proc-macro crates NotYetBuilt and answers sub-requests (blaze_lower::answer); expanders come from blaze_macro_eval::load / blaze-macro-wasm. Tell me by queue when blaze-expand names no load_cargo, so I can delete load-cargo.
